title: Instant Ragi Cerelac Recipe, Millet Cereal for Babies
title_hi: इंस्टेंट रागी सेरेलेक रेसिपी, शिशुओं के लिए बाजरा अनाज
content:
These powders are great to have handy when traveling since they require no cooking you can just add some milk or water and feed your baby. I am sure you will be feeling so happy when you feed your baby with these instead of the packaged stuff. I will try to share many more recipes similar to this for you. So give this a try and let me know how it turns out for you. 

 

Preparation Time: 10 mins

Baking Time: 20 mins

Makes: 2 cups of powder

 

Ingredients:

 

Ragi Flour / Finger millet flour – 1 cup

Rock Sugar or Panakarkandu – 1/2 cup

Ghee or Melted Butter – 1/4 cup

Milk or Water – 2 tablespooon

 

Method:

 

Preheat oven to 180 degrees C.

Powder rock sugar and set aside.

Take ragi flour in a dry pan and roast it on low heat for 5 to 6 mins till the raw smell leaves from it.

Take all ingredients in a bowl and knead to a dough. Add milk if needed.

Now roll this between two sheets of plastic wrap.

Trim off the edges and cut into squares.

Remove it carefully using a spatula and place on a foil-lined baking sheet.

Bake it for 15 to 18 mins till golden. It will be soft when you take from oven, it will harden as it cools down.

Let it cool completely.

Now take this in a blender and powder finely.

Now for making cereal, take some powder in a bowl and add hot milk or water and mix till it reaches the right texture.

Feed your baby.

 

Notes:

 

1)This powder can be stored in room temp. But for safety purpose store it in the fridge.

2)You can take this while traveling.

3)Instead of hot water or milk. You can use warm or cold water or milk.

4)Start with little water or milk and add more as per the consistency needed,

5)Instead of making powder, this can be given as biscuits too.

6)If making for babies under 7 months, skip the badam powder.

 

This is an instant, No-cook cerelac for baby. You can prepare this cereal in a few different ways.

1)You can add warm water or milk to make this cereal. 

2)You can use normal water or milk to make this cereal, in which case the texture will be a little coarse.

3)You can add boiling water or milk to make this cereal, in which case the texture will be so smooth.

4)You can add some powdered jaggery or sugar to this, add some ghee and make ladoo.

5)For making soft-cooked balls. Take this powder in a saucepan, add some milk and mix. Add more sugar or jaggery as needed, add little ghee and cook this on low heat till it comes as a ball. Take a small portion from this and shape it into balls.
content_hi:
ये पाउडर काम करने के लिए बहुत बढ़िया होते हैं क्योंकि उन्हें यात्रा करने की आवश्यकता नहीं होती है क्योंकि आपको सिर्फ दूध या पानी मिला कर अपने बच्चे को खिलाना है। मुझे यकीन है कि जब आप पैक किए गए सामान की जगह अपने बच्चे को खिलाएंगे तो आप बहुत खुश महसूस करेंगे। मैं आपके लिए इसके समान कई और व्यंजनों को साझा करने का प्रयास करूंगा। तो यह एक कोशिश दे और मुझे बताएं कि यह आपके लिए कैसे निकला।

 

तैयारी का समय: 10 मिनट

बेकिंग टाइम: 20 मिनट

बनाता है: 2 कप पाउडर

 

सामग्री:

 

रागी आटा / फिंगर बाजरा का आटा - 1 कप

रॉक शुगर या पनाकरकांडु - 1/2 कप

घी या पिघला हुआ मक्खन - 1/4 कप

दूध या पानी - 2 बड़ा चम्मच

 

तरीका:

 

ओवन को 180 डिग्री C पर प्रीहीट करें।

पाउडर रॉक चीनी और एक तरफ सेट करें।

एक सूखे पैन में रागी का आटा लें और इसे 5 से 6 मिनट तक धीमी आंच पर भूनें जब तक कि इसमें से कच्ची महक न निकल जाए।

एक कटोरे में सभी सामग्री लें और आटा गूंध लें। अगर जरूरत हो तो दूध डालें।

अब इसे प्लास्टिक शीट की दो शीटों के बीच रोल करें।

किनारों को काटें और वर्गों में काट लें।

एक स्पैटुला का उपयोग करके इसे सावधानी से निकालें और पन्नी-पंक्तिबद्ध बेकिंग शीट पर रखें।

इसे सुनहरा होने तक 15 से 18 मिनट तक बेक करें। यह नरम होगा जब आप ओवन से लेते हैं, तो यह ठंडा हो जाएगा।

इसे पूरी तरह से ठंडा होने दें।

अब इसे एक ब्लेंडर और पाउडर में बारीक लें।

अब अनाज बनाने के लिए, एक कटोरे में कुछ पाउडर लें और गर्म दूध या पानी डालें और इसे तब तक मिलाएं जब तक यह सही बनावट में न आ जाए।

अपने बच्चे को खिलाओ।

 

टिप्पणियाँ:

 

1) यह पाउडर कमरे के अस्थायी में संग्रहीत किया जा सकता है। लेकिन सुरक्षा उद्देश्य के लिए इसे फ्रिज में स्टोर करें।

2) यात्रा के दौरान आप इसे ले सकते हैं।

3) गर्म पानी या दूध के बजाय। आप गर्म या ठंडे पानी या दूध का उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

4) थोड़ा पानी या दूध के साथ शुरू करें और आवश्यकता के अनुसार अधिक जोड़ें,

5) पाउडर बनाने के बजाय इसे बिस्कुट के रूप में भी दिया जा सकता है।

6) अगर 7 महीने से कम उम्र के बच्चों के लिए बना रहे हैं, तो बदम पाउडर को छोड़ दें।

 

यह शिशु के लिए एक त्वरित, नो-कुक सेरेलैक है। आप इस अनाज को कुछ अलग तरीकों से तैयार कर सकते हैं।

1) इस अनाज को बनाने के लिए आप गर्म पानी या दूध मिला सकते हैं।

2) आप इस अनाज को बनाने के लिए सामान्य पानी या दूध का उपयोग कर सकते हैं, इस मामले में बनावट थोड़ा मोटे हो जाएगी।

3) आप इस अनाज को बनाने के लिए उबलते पानी या दूध को जोड़ सकते हैं, जिस स्थिति में बनावट इतनी चिकनी होगी।

४) आप इसमें थोड़ा सा गुड़ या चीनी मिला सकते हैं, थोड़ा घी डालकर लड्डू बना सकते हैं।

5) नरम-पकाया गेंदों बनाने के लिए। इस पाउडर को सॉस पैन में लें, थोड़ा दूध डालें और मिलाएं। आवश्यकतानुसार अधिक चीनी या गुड़ डालें, थोड़ा घी डालें और इसे धीमी आँच पर तब तक पकाएँ जब तक यह एक गेंद के रूप में न आ जाए। इसमें से एक छोटा हिस्सा लें और इसे बॉल्स में आकार दें।

related.title: Tasty Oven Roasted Chicken ( With Vegetables ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी ओवेन रोस्टेड चिकन (सब्जियों के साथ) रेसिपी
related.content:
Delicious and very easy roast chicken with veggies tastes so yummy. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Healthy chicken with veggies.

This is an easy dinner or lunch to put together. It takes less than 10 mins to put together. Once you assembled everything it takes around 40 to 45 mins to cook. The chicken is so flavourful and tastes so juicy. The chicken outside has a nice crust in them and the inside is so juicy.

 

Roast Chicken with Vegetables

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 5 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 1 whole chicken, cut into 12 pieces

Oil - 3 tablespoons

Carrot - 2 chopped

Cauliflower - 2 cups

Onion - 1 chopped

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Garlic - 10 cloves with skins on

 

FOR SPICE MIX:

Red Chilli Flakes - 1 tablespoon

Chilli Powder or Paprika - 1 tablespoon

Salt - 1 tablespoon

Parsley - 2 tablespoons

Oregano - 1 tablespoon

Sumac - 2 tablespoons

 

Instructions

Preheat oven to 200 degrees C. Mix spice mix together and set aside.

Take veggies in a baking pan. Add spice mix and oil and toss well.

Place chicken over it and sprinkle with spice mix and oil and mix well.

Pop it in the oven and bake for 35 to 45 mins.

Remove and serve it.

related.title: Tasty Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe
related.content:
Delicious spicy chicken curry made using roasted spice masala and coconut masala which is so yummy with rice.

This chicken curry is made using roasted whole spices masala which tastes super delicious. The freshly roasted spices give so much flavor to the chicken curry and make it super yummy.

 

Varutharacha Chicken Curry Recipe

Prep time: 15 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 1 hour

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 6 serving

 

Ingredients

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Fennel seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 2 teaspoons

Cumin Seeds / Jeerakam - 1 teaspoon

Bay Leaf - 1

Cardamom / Yelakai - 5

Cloves / Krambu - 5

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Brinji Ilai / Pandan Leaf - 1

Chicken - 1 kg

Shallots - 30 peeled and chopped finely

Tomato - 4 to 5 chopped finely

Green Chillies - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Potato - 1 peeled and cubed

Salt to taste

Tomato - 1 chopped for adding last

Curry Leaves a handful for adding last

 

TO ROAST & GRIND:

Dry Red Chilli - 10 to 12

Coriander Leaves - 4 tablespoons

Cumin Seeds - 2 teaspoons

Black Pepper - 2 teaspoons

Curry leaves a handful

TO GRIND:

Coconut - 1 cup grated

Roasted Gram Dal / Pori Kadalai - 1 teaspoon

Fennel Seeds / Sombu / Saunf - 1 teaspoon

 

Instructions

Heat a pan, add whole spices to toast. Cook till golden. Take it in a blender and puree till smooth. Set aside.

Take coconut, gram dal, fennel and grind to a smooth paste.

Now heat oil in a pan, add in whole spices, onions and cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and saute till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and curry leaves and mix well.

Add in chicken and cook till 5 to 6 mins.

Add in roasted coconut masala and water. Mix well.

Add this in a pressure cooker and cook for 2 whistles.

Take it off the heat and open the cooker.

Add in potatoes and cook till it is done.

Add in coconut masala and simmer for 10 to 15 mins.

Take the curry off the heat and add in tomato and curry leaves.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Pepper Chicken ( Milagu )  Gravy Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी काली मिर्च चिकन (मिलगु) ग्रेवी रेसिपी
related.content:
Spicy black pepper chicken gravy goes well with roti, rice or idli or dosa too. This spicy chicken curry tastes super delicious and very peppery.

I have shared a few varieties of pepper chicken and mutton recipes here. But I haven’t shared the pepper chicken gravy which we simply love. I make this all the time. So here it is. It is not at all hard to make, it is super easy to make and taste simply amazing.

 

Pepper Chicken Gravy Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 45 mins

Total time: 55 mins

 

Recipe type: Main

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 4 servings

 

Ingredients

Chicken - 500 grams

Coconut Oil - ¼ cup

Bay Leaf - 1

Onion - 2 large sliced thinly

Green Chilli - 2 slit

Ginger Garlic Paste - 2 tablespoons

Tomatoes - 2 large chopped finely

Turmeric Powder - 1 teaspoon

Chilli powder - 2 teaspoons

Garam Masala Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Coriander Leaves for garnishing

 

FOR ROASTING & GRINDING:

Oil - 1 tsp

Fennel Seeds / Saunf / Sombu - 1 tablespoon

Cinnamon / Pattai - 1 stick

Black Pepper - 1 tablespoon

Coriander Seeds - 2 tablespoons

Onion - 1 large chopped

 

Instructions

Pressure cook chicken with a little salt for 2 to 3 whistles. Set aside.

Heat little oil in a pot. Add in spices and toast them. Take it in a blender.

Add onions and cook till golden brown. Add it with the spices and grind till smooth. Set aside.

Heat oil in a pot, add in onions, chilies and bay leaf. Cook till golden.

Add in ginger garlic paste and cook till raw smell leaves.

Add in tomatoes and cook till mushy.

Add in the ground masala and mix well.

Add salt, turmeric powder, chili powder, and garam masala and cook till oil separates.

Now add in the chicken along with any cooking liquid.

Mix well and simmer till oil separates.

Add coriander leaves and mix well.

Serve it.

related.title: Tasty Cheesy Chicken Nuggets ( Kids Special ) Recipe
related.title_hi: टेस्टी चीज चिकन नगेट्स (किड्स स्पेशल) रेसिपी
related.content:
Cheesy chicken nuggets will be your kid's new favorite snack. So delicious and these are pan-fried instead of deep frying so it is more healthy.

This is so easy to make, you can make a bunch of these and freeze them. So you can fry them whenever you need them. Many of my readers have been asking for toddler nuggets recipe. I made this for my little one and she loved it to the core.

 

Cheesy Chicken Nuggets Recipe

Prep time: 10 mins

Cook time: 15 mins

Total time: 25 mins

 

Recipe type: Snacks

Cuisine: Indian

Serves: 2 servings

 

Ingredients

Boneless Chicken Breast - 2 cut into strips

Oil for pan-frying

 

FOR CRISPY COATING:

Breadcrumbs - 1 cup

Cheese - ¼ cup grated

Dried Parsley - 1 teaspoon

Garlic Powder - 2 teaspoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

FOR BATTER:

Cornflour - 2 tablespoons

All-Purpose Flour - 4 tablespoons

Salt to taste

Pepper to taste

 

Instructions

Mix all ingredients for crispy coating and set aside.

Take all ingredients for batter and mix well.

Take the chicken and dip in the batter, coat in breadcrumbs.

Now pan fry till golden brown on each side.

Serve with ketchup.
